  public enum Choice
    Empty
    Pair <named>
      left: Long
      marker: Token
      right: Long
  public enum Other
    Empty
    Pair(Long, Token, Long)
  public enum Flag
    Off
    On
    @NoGC
  public fun make(left: Long, right: Long): Choice
    =
      MethodCall Pair
        Var Choice
        Argument left=
          Var left
        Argument marker=
          Call Token
        Argument right=
          Var right
    @NoGC
  public fun empty(): Choice
    =
      FieldAccess Empty
        Var Choice
    @NoGC
  public fun sum(value: Choice): Long
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Empty
          IntLiteral 0
        arm Pair{left, right, ..}
          Binary Add
            Var left
            Var right
    @NoGC
  public fun flag(): Flag
    =
      FieldAccess On
        Var Flag
    @NoGC
  public fun flagValue(value: Flag): Long
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Off
          IntLiteral 0
        arm On
          IntLiteral 1
